curated_entries.definition: The first of the three principal paths: the definite wish to emerge from cyclic life, marked by the absence of even a moment's wish for the good things of cyclic life, day and night. HGM consistently renders this 'renunciation.'

examples.hgm_english: There's no way to end, without pure renunciation, this striving for pleasant results in the ocean of life.
examples.citation: C01, Reading One, Three Principal Paths v. 4

examples.hgm_english: When you begin to think both night and day of achieving freedom, you've found renunciation.
examples.citation: C01, Reading One, Three Principal Paths v. 5
